articles.summary: President Donald Trump is focusing on drug pricing today, with his administration set to announce all 50 states will see most-favored-nation pricing for certain drugs in Medicaid programs, according to Trump administration plans shared first with Semafor. The White House Council of Economic Advisers estimates the effort will result in $27.6 billion in net savings for state governments and $36.6 billion in federal savings over 10 years. Trump will host the governors of South Dakota, Mississippi, and Arkansas in the Oval Office to tout work on lower drug prices, which Republicans hope to turn into a winning midterms message.
